parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem:
A $15\text{ V}$ battery with negligible internal resistance is connected to two resistors P and Q, as shown in Fig. 6.1.

{{figure:figure_6_1}}

The resistors are made of wires of the same material. The wire of P has diameter $d$ and length $2l$. The wire of Q has diameter $2d$ and length $l$.

The resistance of P is $12\Omega$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Show that the resistance of Q is $1.5\Omega$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the total power dissipated in the resistors P and Q.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
Determine the ratio
$$\frac{\text{average drift speed of the charge carriers in P}}{\text{average drift speed of the charge carriers in Q}}.$$
